content.text: I'll help you create an accessibility audit script. Let me first check the structure of your design tokens.
Now I'll create the audit script that checks each foreground token's contrast against the background.

input.content:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

TOKENS_FILE="tokens.json"

if [ ! -f "$TOKENS_FILE" ]; then
  echo "Error: $TOKENS_FILE not found"
  exit 1
fi

BACKGROUND=$(jq -r '.background' "$TOKENS_FILE")

echo "Accessibility Audit Report"
echo "Background: $BACKGROUND"
echo "Target: WCAG AA (4.5:1 contrast for body text)"
echo "---"

# Iterate through each foreground token
jq -r '.foreground | to_entries[] | "\(.key)|\(.value)"' "$TOKENS_FILE" | while IFS='|' read -r NAME COLOR; do
  RESULT=$(klar contrast "$COLOR" "$BACKGROUND" --json)
  CONTRAST=$(echo "$RESULT" | jq -r '.contrast')

  STATUS=$(awk -v c="$CONTRAST" 'BEGIN { print (c >= 4.5 ? "PASS" : "FAIL") }')
  echo "$NAME: $CONTRAST ($STATUS)"
done
